facts.statement: Overoraptor is an extinct genus of paravian theropod with uncertain affinities from the Early Cretaceous of Patagonia, Argentina.
facts.quote: Overoraptor (, meaning "piebald thief") is an extinct genus of paravian theropod of uncertain affinities from the Early Cretaceous Huincul Formation of Argentinian Patagonia.

facts.statement: The genus contains one species, O. chimentoi, known from fragmentary bones of the hands, feet, hips, and vertebrae.
facts.quote: The genus contains a single species, O. chimentoi, known from several bones of the hands, feet, and hips alongside some vertebrae.

facts.statement: Fossils were found by Dr. Roberto Nicolás Chimento at the Violante Farm locality in Rio Negro Province, Argentina.
facts.quote: The fossil specimens of Overoraptor were unearthed by Dr. Roberto Nicolás Chimento in the Violante Farm locality, which is southeast of the Ezequiel Ramos-Mexía lake, in the northwestern portion of Rio Negro Province, Argentina.

facts.statement: Overoraptor was described as a new genus and species in May 2020 by Motta, Agnolín, Brissón Egli, and Novas.
facts.quote: The fossils were described as a new genus and species of paravian theropod in May 2020 by Matías Motta, Federico Agnolín, Federico Brissón Egli, and Fernando Novas in the journal The Science of Nature (or Naturwissenschaften).

facts.statement: Researchers estimated Overoraptor was about 1.3 meters long, though its mass was not estimated.
facts.quote: In their 2020 description of the genus, Motta and colleagues estimated that Overoraptor would have been about 1.3 m in length, although they do not provide an estimate of the animal's mass.

facts.statement: Gregory S. Paul estimated Overoraptor was about 3 meters long and weighed about 30 kilograms.
facts.quote: Gregory S. Paul estimated the size of Overoraptor to be about 3 m long and weighing about 30 kg.

facts.statement: Overoraptor possessed a short, robust second toe claw typical of dromaeosaurs.
facts.quote: The foot also bears the archetypal raptorial second digit (the characteristic toe claw of dromaeosaurs), which is short in length and proportionally robust relative to other taxa with this claw.

facts.statement: Phylogenetic analyses have placed Overoraptor in various positions, but the most supported tree places it as the sister taxon of Rahonavis.
facts.quote: Their analyses recovered Overoraptor in a variety of positions including as a basal maniraptoran, a basal pennaraptoran, and a basal paravian, but they found the tree with the highest support values in their analysis recovered Overoraptor as the sister taxon of Rahonavis in a clade that is the sister-taxon of avialae and to which unenlagiidae is basal.

facts.statement: Researchers suggest the grouping of Overoraptor with Rahonavis may result from a unique mix of primitive and derived traits in Overoraptor.
facts.quote: Even considering the similarities between the two taxa, Motta and colleagues also remark that the recovery of this clade may be the result of the unique mix of plesiomorphic and derived characters present in Overoraptor.

facts.statement: Overoraptor lived during the Aptian stage of the Cretaceous period.
facts.quote: This outcrop is part of the Huincul Formation, which is dated to the Aptian stage in the Cretaceous period.

facts.statement: Overoraptor's metacarpals were unusually wide, short, and asymmetrical compared to other non-avian paravians.
facts.quote: The metacarpal bones of Overoraptor were noted by Motta and colleagues to be unusual in shape, namely that it is proportionally much wider and shorter than those known from other non-avialan paravians and there is a distinctly asymmetrical ginglymoidal surface which articulates with the lateral condyle.

facts.statement: Overoraptor had a curved ulna, representing the primitive condition for paravians.
facts.quote: The ulna itself is also curved, which is the plesiomorphic condition in paravians, unlike the straight ulnae of Anchiornis and related taxa.

facts.statement: The name Overoraptor combines the Spanish word for "piebald" and the Latin word for "thief".
facts.quote: The generic name, Overoraptor, comes from the Spanish word "overo", meaning "piebald"—referencing the coloration of the fossils—and the Latin word "raptor", meaning "thief".

facts.statement: The species name chimentoi honors Dr. Roberto Nicolás Chimento, who discovered the remains.
facts.quote: El nombre específico, chimentoi, es en honor al Dr. Roberto Nicolás Chimento, quien descubrió los restos.

facts.statement: The holotype and paratype specimens were found in a quarry 1.5 meters in diameter and 0.30 meters deep, south of the Ezequiel Ramos Mexía reservoir in Río Negro Province.
facts.quote: Los especímenes del holotipo MPCA-Pv 805 y del paratipo MPCA-Pv 818 de Overoraptor chimentoi fueron hallados en una cantera con un diámetro de 1,5 m y una profundidad de 0,30 m, al sur del embalse Ezequiel Ramos Mexía, en la provincia de Río Negro.

facts.statement: The dinosaur was found in the Huincul Formation deposits and lived in the Gondwana continental block, now Río Negro Province, Argentina.
facts.quote: Fue hallado en depósitos de la Formación Huincul, y vivió durante el Cretácico superior en el bloque continental Gondwana, actual provincia de Río Negro, Argentina.

facts.statement: The generic name Overoraptor derives from 'overo' because its bones were preserved in a white and black color pattern.
facts.quote: El nombre genérico Overoraptor deriva de overo, por las características de sus huesos, conservados en un patrón de color blanco y negro.

facts.statement: Overoraptor chimentoi was a gracile theropod measuring approximately 1.3 meters in length, with long arms and legs.
facts.quote: Overoraptor chimentoi era un terópodo grácil que medía aproximadamente 1,3 m de largo, con brazos y patas largas.

facts.statement: The hind limb showed features very similar to those of running animals, indicating it was very fast.
facts.quote: El miembro posterior presentaba rasgos muy similares a los de los animales corredores, lo que indica que era muy veloz.

facts.statement: The legs possessed a large, curved, and sharp claw on the second toe, similar to unenlagiids.
facts.quote: Además, las patas tenían una gran garra curvada y filosa en el segundo dedo al igual que los unenlágidos.

facts.statement: Anatomical study of the arm bones revealed it shared characteristics with birds that other raptor dinosaurs lacked.
facts.quote: En el estudio anatómico de los huesos de los brazos, los investigadores observaron que compartía características con las aves que no tienen otros dinosaurios raptores.

facts.statement: Phylogenetic analysis placed Overoraptor and Rahonavis in a novel position, excluding them from the clades Unenlagiidae and Avialae where Rahonavis was previously classified.
facts.quote: El análisis filogenético situó en una posición novedosa al Overoraptor y al Rahonavis, excluyéndolos de los clados Unenlagiidae y Avialae, dentro de los cuales se solía clasificar al Rahonavis.

facts.statement: These two species had raptor-type feet and bird-wing-like arms, features absent in Northern Hemisphere unenlagiids and velociraptors.
facts.quote: Estas dos especies tenían el pie de tipo raptor y brazos similares a las alas de las aves cuyas características estaban ausentes en los unenlágidos y velocirraptores del hemisferio norte.

facts.statement: These characteristics suggest these two species might belong to a new group of running paravians, phylogenetically closer to birds than to raptors.
facts.quote: Dichas características indicarían que estas dos especies podrían pertenecer a un nuevo grupo de paravianos corredores, que sería más cercano filogenéticamente a las aves que a los raptores.

facts.statement: The Paleobiology Database lists the time range for the genus Overoraptor as Albian to Albian (110.1 to 106.3 million years ago).
facts.quote: Time range: Albian to Albian (110.1 to 106.3 million years ago)

facts.statement: The parent group for the genus Overoraptor is Paraves.
facts.quote: Parent group: Paraves

facts.statement: The genus Overoraptor is classified under the class Reptilia.
facts.quote: Class: Reptilia

rejected.statement: Overoraptor chimentoi lived during the mid-Cretaceous, approximately 97 to 93 million years ago (Cenomanian to Turonian), in what is now South America.
rejected.quote: Overoraptor chimentoi es la única especie conocida del género extinto Overoraptor... dinosaurio terópodo paraviano que vivió a mediados del período Cretácico hace aproximadamente entre 97 a 93 millones de años durante el Cenomaniense al Turoniense, en lo que es hoy Sudamérica.
